component.name: ContentModule
component.description: Discovery module: optional section title, horizontal filter chips (radiogroup), and a CardCarousel of editorial content cards with category overline rules.

antiPatterns.reason: Horizontal exploration hides items and reduces scan speed.

contentRules: Parent owns filtering and personalization: pass `articles` already filtered for `filterValue`.
When `filterValue` equals `allFilterValue`, show `contentCategoryLabel` on each card; when a specific category is selected, omit labels to avoid redundancy.
Hide the entire module when there is no content to show (parent decision); empty filtered state shows `emptyStateLabel` inside the module.
Use `linkLabel` for the inline reinforcement string (default Leer artículo); the whole card is the primary navigation target when `href` is set.

nestedComponents: Chip pattern (filter chips are module-local radiogroup styling)
rules: Filter strip uses disconnected pill buttons in a horizontal scroller; it is not the connected SegmentedControl bar.
Cards use `elevation=none` for editorial rail parity with reference layouts.
Description text is clamped to two lines via `.musky-content-module` scope.

layout.behavior: Title is static; filters scroll horizontally; carousel reuses CardCarousel track behavior.

accessibility.keyboardSupport: Filter uses radiogroup semantics; carousel track is keyboard scrollable.
accessibility.screenReader: Section may be labelled by the optional title; empty state uses role=status.
accessibility.focusManagement: Filter chips are individual radio buttons; one selection at a time for the default module.

aiHints.context: Compose from Card + CardCarousel; keep personalization and filtering in parent state or services.
